create_graph: create a gtn Graph object with sorted or unsorted arcs for building finite state transducers
add_node: add an initial or final node to a gtn Graph using add_node with is_initial and is_final flags
add_arc: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn Graph with a symbol label using add_arc
draw_graph: draw a gtn Graph to a PDF file with symbol and state labels using gtn.draw
union_graphs: compute the union of multiple gtn Graph objects using gtn.union to combine them into one
